tasks.label: Build Release (clean)
tasks.command: & 'C:/Program Files/Microsoft Visual Studio/18/Community/Common7/IDE/CommonExtensions/Microsoft/CMake/CMake/bin/cmake.exe' --build '${workspaceFolder}/build' --config Release --clean-first --target ALL_BUILD -j 20 | Tee-Object -FilePath '${workspaceFolder}/build/last_build.log'; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $errs = @(Select-String -Path '${workspaceFolder}/build/last_build.log' -Pattern ': (fatal )?error [A-Z]+[0-9]+' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Select-Object -Unique); Write-Host ''; if ($errs.Count) { Write-Host ('===== ' + $errs.Count + ' ERREUR(S) =====') -ForegroundColor Red; $errs | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ -ForegroundColor Red } } else { Write-Host '===== BUILD OK, aucune erreur =====' -ForegroundColor Green }; exit $(if ($null -eq $code) { 1 } else { $code })
